```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
```

Ablation 1.2

```{r}
ablation <- data.frame(
  size = c(100, 1000),
  o0 = c(1.4374, 1577.52),
  o1 = c(0.204426, 181.837),
  o2 = c(0.318932, 245.472),
  o3 = c(0.253026, 168.824)
)

ablation_long <- ablation %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = o0:o3,
    names_to = "optimization",
    values_to = "runtime"
  ) %>%
  group_by(size) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline = runtime[optimization == "o0"],
    speedup = baseline / runtime
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    size = factor(size),
    optimization = factor(
      optimization,
      levels = c("o0", "o1", "o2", "o3")
    )
  )

p_ablation <- ggplot(
  ablation_long,
  aes(x = optimization, y = speedup, fill = size)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2fx", speedup)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Optimization",
    y = "Speedup Relative to o0",
    fill = "Matrix Size"
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = 10) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_ablation

ggsave(
  "ablation_cpu.png",
  p_ablation,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

Scalability 1.3

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

scalability <- data.frame(
  size = c(100, 1000, 5000, 10000),
  runtime = c(0.190505, 175.216, 25174, 202742)
)

p_scalability <- ggplot(
  scalability,
  aes(x = size, y = runtime)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::label_number(big.mark = ",", accuracy = 0.1)(runtime)),
    vjust = -1.2,
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Matrix Size (N = M = K)",
    y = "Runtime (ms, log scale)"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(100, 1000, 5000, 10000),
    labels = c("100", "1,000", "5,000", "10,000"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ","), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_scalability

ggsave(
  "scalability_cpu.png",
  p_scalability,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

Scalability 2.3

```{r}
library(scales)

scalability_gpu <- data.frame(
  size = c(100, 1000, 5000, 10000),
  runtime = c(0.0282976, 3.5825, 275.213, 2250.46)
)

p_scalability_gpu <- ggplot(
  scalability_gpu,
  aes(x = size, y = runtime)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label_number(accuracy = 0.01, big.mark = ",")(runtime)),
    vjust = -1,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Matrix Size (N = M = K)",
    y = "Runtime (ms, log scale)"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(100, 1000, 5000, 10000),
    labels = label_comma()
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ","),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))  # extra headroom for labels
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_scalability_gpu

ggsave(
  "scalability_gpu.png",
  p_scalability_gpu,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

cuBLAS

```{r}
scalability_gpu_compare <- data.frame(
  size = c(100, 1000, 5000, 10000, 20000),
  o3 = c(0.0282976, 3.5825, 275.213, 2250.46, 17919),
  cuBLAS = c(0.022336, 0.523424, 43.3374, 454.022, 3640.87)
)

scalability_gpu_compare_long <- scalability_gpu_compare %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(o3, cuBLAS),
    names_to = "implementation",
    values_to = "runtime"
  )

p_scalability_gpu_compare <- ggplot(
  scalability_gpu_compare_long,
  aes(
    x = size,
    y = runtime,
    color = implementation,
    group = implementation
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label_number(accuracy = 0.01, big.mark = ",")(runtime)),
    vjust = -1,
    size = 3.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Matrix Size (N = M = K)",
    y = "Runtime (ms, log scale)",
    color = "Implementation"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(100, 1000, 5000, 10000, 20000),
    labels = label_comma()
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ","),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_scalability_gpu_compare

ggsave(
  "scalability_gpu_cublas.png",
  p_scalability_gpu_compare,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```
